elements.text: Chandrayaan-3 terrain reconstruction  |  Evidence snapshot: 9 Nov 2026

Parameter	Strict	Relaxed completion
SGBM block / uniqueness	5 × 5 / 15	7 × 7 / 5
Left–right error	≤1 px	≤2 px
Local texture standard deviation	≥2	≥1
Speckle component size	100	50
Support median / neighbours	≤2 px / ≥8	≤3 px / ≥5
Support component size	≥200 pixels	≥50 pixels
New terrain-cell acceptance	Original occupied median	≤20 cm from support; height envelope
